name: sure
description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
one_liner: A full personal finance app — think Mint, but self-hosted and open source — that tracks your bank accounts, budgets, and net worth in one place.
buyer: A privacy-conscious household that got burned when Mint shut down and doesn't want their financial data living on someone else's servers.
business_use_cases: A fee-only financial advisor self-hosts it for each client as a free, transparent net-worth and budget dashboard instead of paying for a commercial client-portal tool.
A fintech team forks it as the UI and backend skeleton for a new budgeting product instead of building account-aggregation and net-worth tracking from scratch.
A credit union offers 'we'll set this up for you' as a value-add member service, hosted on their own infrastructure for privacy-focused members.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed hosting (so users don't have to self-host) with bank-sync included
Sell a concierge setup-and-import service for people migrating off Mint or YNAB who don't want to do the technical work themselves

steal_this: Launch a $5/month hosted version this weekend aimed at the wave of ex-Mint refugees still looking for a home — the app itself is already built and open source.
